parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content in the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Vendor
parameters.description:
The service provider of cloud assets. Valid values:

*   **Tencent**, **HUAWEICLOUD**, **Azure**, and **AWS**: other service providers of cloud assets.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-cloud-vendor-regions --vendor Tencent --lang en --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListCloudVendorRegions --region cn-hangzhou --Lang en --Vendor Tencent
